This is a generic recipe for '''fruit crumble'''. You may use a variety of fruits.

==Ingredients==
* 85 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (3 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]] or [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 170 g (6 oz) [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* [[Cookbook:Fruit|Fruit]]
* Spoonful [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]

==Procedure==
# Rub together margarine and flour until crumbly.
# Add the fruit to an oven-safe bowl. Sprinkle sugar onto the fruit.
# Sprinkle a thick layer of the crumble over the fruit.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the oven at 160°C (320°F) for 30 minutes.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* You can use a variety of fruits in this recipe, including but not limited to:
** [[Cookbook:Apple|Apples]], peeled, cored, and cut in pieces
** [[Cookbook:Blackberry|Blackberries]]
** [[Cookbook:Raspberry|Raspberries]]
** [[Cookbook:Blueberry|Blueberries]]
* Alter the time and temperature to suit the oven. The time and temperature may also need adjusting for different sizes of fruit crumble.
* This recipe can be adapted for people with an allergy by substituting the ingredients for equivalents. For example, to make this suitable for people with milk or dairy allergy use a dairy-free margarine.
